propositions: Every newly certified plan review must emit exactly one deterministic pin per direct child and normalized prerequisite, with roles of child or prerequisite, sorted lexicographically by role then canonical ID.

Pin lines must appear in the manifest after verified-at-sha and before dep lines, each containing role, canonical-ticket-id, and 16-lowercase-hex material fingerprint from material_fingerprint(PlanContext).

PlanRelationSnapshot must preload ticket_states_by_id store-wide including archived states, scan inbound block relations across that map, and resolve aliases/prefixes before deduplication to discover all inbound blockers.

Every unreadable, unresolvable, or missing target must return unsigned INDETERMINATE with exact PlanRelationSnapshotError reason before any LLM call, producing a structured ERROR log and no traceback.

tracker_head_sha() must verify clean tickets-tracker state via git status --porcelain and ls-files -u, then capture 40-hex HEAD; any output, git failure, or malformed result raises PlanRelationSnapshotError with reason store-read-failure.

Pin collection must run unconditionally on every ordinary sign_plan_review, refresh_attestation, and resign_plan_review path without configuration conditionals; legacy manifests without pins remain parseable and authenticated.
